title: Riding Two-Wheeler Without Helmet or Defective Helmet
description: Mandatory requirement for driver and pillion rider of a two-wheeler to wear protective headgear conforming to Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) standards.
violation: Driving or riding a motorcycle/scooter without wearing protective headgear or wearing non-BIS compliant helmet.
additionalPenalty: Disqualification of driving licence for a period of 3 months.
legalSection: Section 194D of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
sourceName: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (MoRTH) / India Code
governmentDocument: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)
notes: Applies nationwide under Central Motor Vehicles Act.

title: Driving Without Seat Belt
description: Mandatory requirement for driver and front/rear seat passengers in a motor vehicle to wear seat belts while vehicle is in motion.
violation: Driving a light motor vehicle or passenger car without wearing a seat belt or allowing passengers to travel unbelted.
additionalPenalty: Mandatory road safety counseling in specified jurisdictions.
legalSection: Section 194B(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
governmentDocument: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)

title: Driving by a Drunken Person or Under the Influence of Drugs
description: Driving or attempting to drive a motor vehicle with alcohol content exceeding 30 mg per 100 ml of blood detected in a breath analyzer test.
violation: Operating motor vehicle under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs.
additionalPenalty: Imprisonment up to 6 months for 1st offense; ₹15,000 fine and/or up to 2 years imprisonment for 2nd offense.
legalSection: Section 185 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
sourceName: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (MoRTH) / India Code
governmentDocument: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)
notes: Zero tolerance policy for commercial drivers.

title: Use of Handheld Mobile Phone While Driving
description: Prohibition of using handheld communications devices, mobile phones, or interactive technology while driving motor vehicle.
violation: Holding or operating mobile phone while driving motor vehicle.
additionalPenalty: Imprisonment from 6 months to 1 year for 1st offense; up to ₹10,000 fine for 2nd offense.
legalSection: Section 184(c) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
governmentDocument: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)
notes: Hands-free navigation permitted if phone is securely mounted.

title: Over Speeding - Light Motor Vehicle
description: Exceeding prescribed statutory speed limits on national highways, expressways, or urban roads for Light Motor Vehicles.
violation: Driving light motor vehicle at a speed exceeding statutory speed limit.
additionalPenalty: Impounding of driving licence for 2nd or subsequent offense.
legalSection: Section 183(1)(a) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
governmentDocument: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)

title: Red Light Signal Jumping & Traffic Light Violation
description: Jumping red traffic signal, failing to stop at mandatory stop line, or disobeying manual traffic signals by authorized officers.
violation: Proceeding through intersection when traffic signal is red or flashing red.
additionalPenalty: License suspension for up to 3 months for habitual offenders.
legalSection: Section 184(a) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
governmentDocument: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)

title: Driving Against Authorized Traffic Flow (Wrong Side Driving)
description: Driving motor vehicle against designated direction of traffic flow on one-way streets, dual carriageways, or expressways.
violation: Operating vehicle in opposite direction of one-way traffic stream.
additionalPenalty: Imprisonment from 6 months to 1 year for 1st offense.
legalSection: Section 184(b) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
governmentDocument: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)

title: Driving Motor Vehicle Without Valid Driving Licence
description: Driving a motor vehicle in any public place without holding an effective driving licence issued by a competent licensing authority.
violation: Operating motor vehicle without possessing valid driving licence for that category.
additionalPenalty: Community service or impounding of vehicle.
legalSection: Section 181 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
sourceName: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (MoRTH) / India Code
governmentDocument: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)
notes: Vehicle owner also liable under Section 180.

title: Driving Vehicle Without Valid Registration Certificate
description: Driving or permitting use of an unregistered motor vehicle or vehicle with expired registration on public roads.
violation: Operating motor vehicle without valid RC or high-security registration plate.
additionalPenalty: Fine up to ₹10,000 and/or 1 year imprisonment for subsequent offense.
legalSection: Section 192 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
governmentDocument: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)

title: Driving Motor Vehicle Without Valid Third-Party Insurance
description: Driving or allowing operation of motor vehicle without valid third-party insurance coverage required under Chapter XI.
violation: Operating vehicle without valid third-party insurance certificate.
additionalPenalty: Imprisonment up to 3 months for 1st offense; ₹4,000 fine for 2nd offense.
legalSection: Section 196 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
sourceName: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (MoRTH) / India Code
governmentDocument: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)

title: Violation of Emission Standards / Driving Without Valid PUC Certificate
description: Driving motor vehicle violating prescribed road safety, noise, or air pollution standard guidelines.
violation: Operating vehicle without valid Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate or emitting excessive smoke.
additionalPenalty: Disqualification of driving licence for 3 months.
legalSection: Section 190(2) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
governmentDocument: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)
notes: Strictly enforced across NCR and metro zones.

title: Obstruction of Emergency Vehicles (Ambulance, Fire Brigade)
description: Failure to draw out vehicle to side of road to allow free passage to emergency service vehicles (ambulance, fire tender).
violation: Blocking or failing to yield right of way to emergency vehicles.
legalSection: Section 194E of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
sourceName: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (MoRTH) / India Code
governmentDocument: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)

title: Carrying More Than One Pillion Rider on Two-Wheeler (Tripling)
description: Driver of a two-wheeler carrying more than one person in addition to himself on a motorcycle/scooter.
violation: Carrying 2 or more passengers on a two-wheeler motorcycle.
additionalPenalty: Disqualification of driving licence for 3 months.
legalSection: Section 194C of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
governmentDocument: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)
notes: Commonly referred to as tripling violation.

title: Overloading of Goods Vehicle Beyond Permissible Gross Weight
description: Operating a goods carriage loaded beyond maximum permissible gross vehicle weight authorized in registration.
violation: Carrying excess load in commercial goods vehicle.
additionalPenalty: Additional fine of ₹2,000 per extra tonne of excess load + offloading costs.
legalSection: Section 194(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
governmentDocument: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)
notes: Offloading mandatory at weighbridge before vehicle clearance.

title: Illegal Parking on Public Road or Obstruction to Flow of Traffic
description: Parking vehicle in no-parking zone, bus stop, pedestrian path, narrow bridge, or causing obstruction.
violation: Parking vehicle in designated no-parking zone or obstructing traffic movement.
additionalPenalty: Vehicle towing and storage charges as applicable by municipal authority.
legalSection: Section 177A read with Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989
